items.titleZh: 安东内利自嘲巴库「像奶奶开车」：地板受损仍拼到第五
items.summaryZh: 记者亚当·库珀转述基米·安东内利谈巴库冲到第五的表现：他称自己一度「像奶奶开车」，基本在保全模式下不冒险；重启后左侧地板大损、车子很难开，仍想冲第四，最后对第五也满意。

media.altZh: 安东内利自嘲巴库「像奶奶开车」：地板受损仍拼到第五 · 第 1 张

items.originalTitle: Kimi Antonelli when I asked about his percentage drive to P5 in Baku: "I was driving a bit like my grandmother today, just damage save mode."
detailZh: 基米·安东内利在被问到巴库冲到第五时「开了几成」时说：「我今天开得有点像我奶奶，基本就是保全模式。不冒险。每次想超车前，都会先确认能不能做。与此同时，重启之后地板伤得很重，左侧整边都因为接触没了。之后车子开起来很飘，我还是想冲到第四。不过总的来说，这种日子对第五也该满意……」
detailEn: Kimi Antonelli when I asked about his percentage drive to P5 in Baku: "I was driving a bit like my grandmother today, just damage save mode. Just didn't take risk. Before making a move, I was making sure that I could go for it, and at the same time after the restart the big floor damage, my whole left side was gone with the contact. So after that, the car was very sketchy to drive, and I still tried to get to P4. But all in all, it's one of those days where you have to be happy with P5..."

items.originalTitle: Why is the 2026 Bahrain Grand Prix taking place in Malaysia?
items.summaryEn: Due to the war in the Middle East, the original April Bahrain Grand Prix was cancelled, so the 2026 Bahrain Grand Prix will be held from 2-4 October at the Sepang International Circuit near Kuala Lumpur, with the race on Sunday 4 October.
detailZh: 为什么2026年巴林大奖赛要在马来西亚举行？
在马来西亚举办巴林大奖赛：一级方程式从未见过这样的场面。我们解释为什么这场比赛将在雪邦举行，以及为什么它仍将沿用巴林的名字
2026年巴林大奖赛将不在巴林举行，而是在马来西亚举行。赛事将于10月2日至4日在吉隆坡附近的雪邦国际赛道举行，正赛定于10月4日星期日。它的官方名称是“在马来西亚举行的F1海湾航空巴林大奖赛”。
更换举办地的原因是中东的战争。原定于4月举行的巴林站比赛不得不取消。通过在马来西亚举办一场替代赛事，巴林大奖赛得以保留在赛历之上。
巴林大奖赛原定于2026年4月10日至12日举行，是本赛季的第四站。沙特阿拉伯大奖赛原定于一周后举行。2026年3月14日，一级方程式与国际汽联宣布，这两场比赛将不会在4月举行。
这一决定是在涉及伊朗的战争背景下做出的，该战争于2月下旬爆发。伊朗的袭击击中了巴林境内的目标，包括距离赛道仅几公里的燃油设施。整个地区的空中交通也受到严格限制。在这种情况下，无法安全地举办比赛周末。
一级方程式主席兼首席执行官斯特凡诺·多梅尼卡利当时表示：“虽然这是一个艰难的决定，但考虑到当前中东局势，这不幸地是现阶段正确的决定。”
春季没有替补比赛。由于没有足够的准备时间将一场比赛移师欧洲，导致日本大奖赛与迈阿密大奖赛之间出现了五周的空档。
奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里，迈凯伦；亚历山大·阿尔本，威廉姆斯
寻找替代赛道的计划于七月开始成形。最初有消息称，马来西亚正在考虑于2026年举办一场比赛。2026年7月26日，一级方程式和国际汽联正式确认，一级方程式将在阔别九年后重返马来西亚。
赛历和物流是选择雪邦的主要原因。这场比赛位于9月26日的阿塞拜疆大奖赛和10月11日的新加坡大奖赛之间。雪邦与新加坡之间仅相距约320公里。这形成了一个三连赛，而车队无需进行大规模的物流绕行。
还有就是赛道本身。从1999年到2017年，雪邦一直是一级方程式赛历上的固定站点。这座场馆是为大奖赛而建，在举办一级方程式赛事方面已经拥有丰富的经验。评论员马丁·布伦德尔也赞扬了相关人员所展现出的灵活性。
“这项运动再次证明了它适应变化、寻找解决方案并成功交付的能力，为所有关注一级方程式的车迷创造了一个激动人心的时刻，”多梅尼卡利说。
国际汽联主席本·苏拉耶姆表示，重返雪邦赛道“证明了我们与马来西亚赛车运动协会的紧密关系、马来西亚政府的持续支持，以及我们这项运动中国际合作的力量。”
为什么这项比赛仍然叫巴林大奖赛？
尽管比赛在马来西亚举行，这项赛事仍然保留巴林大奖赛的名称。这是一级方程式、国际汽联以及巴林和马来西亚两国政府之间协议的结果。巴林仍然是大奖赛的名义主办国，而比赛本身在雪邦国际赛道举行。巴林的国家航空公司海湾航空仍然是冠名赞助商。
巴林还决定票价，并根据雪邦国际赛车场的说法，由巴林获得门票销售收入。对巴林来说，这意味着其大奖赛并没有完全从2026年赛历上消失。门票正通过巴林国际赛车场官网销售。海湾航空也将赶在比赛周末之前开通巴林与吉隆坡之间的直飞航班。
巴林国际赛车场首席执行官萨勒曼·本·伊萨·阿勒哈利法亲王表示：“自从我们宣布在马来西亚举办巴林大奖赛以来，车迷和这项运动相关人士的反馈令人难以置信。车迷现在有机会确保自己成为这段独一无二的F1历史的一部分。”
在‘错误’国家举办的大奖赛：以前也发生过
大奖赛在名称所指的国家之外举办，在一级方程式中并非完全没有先例。不过在以往的案例中，出借国名给比赛的国家与实际承办比赛的国家在地理上要接近得多。
1982年瑞士大奖赛在法国第戎举行，因为瑞士在1955年勒芒惨剧之后禁止了场地赛车。
圣马力诺大奖赛于1981年至2006年在意大利的伊莫拉举行。而意大利本身已经在蒙扎拥有自己大奖赛。
1997年和1998年，纽博格林承办了卢森堡大奖赛。
最近一次在雪邦举行的F1比赛由马克斯·维斯塔潘于2017年夺冠。塞巴斯蒂安·维特尔保持着在该赛道最多F1胜利的纪录，共四次。其他令人难忘的时刻包括迈克尔·舒马赫在1999年腿伤康复后的复出，以及刘易斯·汉密尔顿在2016年的引擎故障，这使他在年度冠军争夺战中损失了宝贵的积分。
2026年的比赛将为56圈，总里程310.418公里。一些车队正在为一级方程式重返雪邦做大量准备。例如，梅赛德斯已经宣布为马来西亚站带来一次重大升级。
与此同时，赛季的结束仍存在不确定性。卡塔尔和阿布扎比的比赛也取决于中东局势的发展。多梅尼卡利已经说明了一级方程式需要在什么时候对赛季收官站做出决定。
关于在马来西亚举行的巴林大奖赛的常见问题
比赛周末将于2026年10月2日至4日举行。比赛本身将于10月4日星期日进行。
2026年巴林大奖赛将在哪里举行？
在马来西亚吉隆坡附近的雪邦国际赛道举行。
为什么2026年一级方程式不在巴林比赛？
原定于四月举行的比赛因中东战争而取消。伊朗的袭击击中了巴林境内靠近赛道的多处目标。
为什么在马来西亚举办的这场比赛会被称为巴林大奖赛？
巴林仍然是这项赛事名义上的主办国，并从门票销售中获得收入。巴林的国家航空公司海湾航空仍然是冠名赞助商。
一级方程式上一次在马来西亚比赛是什么时候？
2017年。马克斯·维斯塔潘赢得了最近一届马来西亚大奖赛的冠军。
detailEn: Why is the 2026 Bahrain Grand Prix taking place in Malaysia?
A Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia: Formula 1 has never seen anything quite like it. We explain why the race is taking place at Sepang and why it will still carry the Bahrain name

The 2026 Bahrain Grand Prix will not take place in Bahrain, but in Malaysia. The event will be held from 2-4 October at the Sepang International Circuit near Kuala Lumpur, with the race scheduled for Sunday 4 October. Its official name is the "Formula 1 Gulf Air Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia".

The reason for the move is the war in the Middle East. The original Bahrain race in April had to be cancelled. By staging a replacement event in Malaysia, the Bahrain Grand Prix remains on the calendar.

The Bahrain Grand Prix was originally scheduled to take place on 10-12 April 2026 as the fourth round of the season. The Saudi Arabian Grand Prix was due to follow one week later. On 14 March 2026, Formula 1 and the FIA announced that both races would not take place in April.

The decision came against the backdrop of the war involving Iran, which had begun in late February. Iranian attacks hit targets in Bahrain, including fuel facilities only a few kilometres from the circuit. Air traffic across the region was also severely restricted. Under those circumstances, it was not possible to stage the race weekend safely.

"While this was a difficult decision to take, it is unfortunately the right one at this stage considering the current situation in the Middle East," Formula 1 President and CEO Stefano Domenicali said at the time.
There were no replacement races in the spring. There was not enough preparation time to move an event to Europe, leaving a five-week gap between the Japanese and Miami Grands Prix.
Oscar Piastri, McLaren, Alexander Albon, Williams

Plans for a replacement began to take shape in July. It initially emerged that Malaysia was considering hosting a race in 2026. On 26 July 2026, Formula 1 and the FIA officially confirmed that Formula 1 would return to Malaysia after a nine-year absence.

The calendar and logistics were major reasons for choosing Sepang. The race sits between the Azerbaijan Grand Prix on 26 September and the Singapore Grand Prix on 11 October. Sepang and Singapore are only around 320 kilometres apart. That creates a triple-header without requiring the teams to make a major logistical detour.

Then there is the circuit itself. Sepang was a permanent fixture on the Formula 1 calendar from 1999 to 2017. The venue was built for grand prix racing and already has extensive experience of staging Formula 1 events. Pundit Martin Brundle also praised the flexibility shown by those involved.
"Once again, the sport has demonstrated its ability to adapt, find solutions, and deliver, creating an exciting moment for everyone who follows Formula 1," said Domenicali.

FIA President Mohammed Ben Sulayem said the return to Sepang was "testament to our close relationship with the Motorsports Association of Malaysia, the continued commitment of the Malaysian Government, and the strength of international cooperation within our sport."
Why is it still called the Bahrain Grand Prix?

Despite being held in Malaysia, the event remains the Bahrain Grand Prix. This is the result of an agreement between Formula 1, the FIA and the governments of Bahrain and Malaysia. Bahrain remains the nominal host of the grand prix, while the race itself takes place at the Sepang International Circuit. Bahrain's national airline Gulf Air remains the title sponsor.

Bahrain also determines ticket prices and, according to the Sepang International Circuit, receives the revenue from ticket sales. For Bahrain, this means its Grand Prix has not disappeared entirely from the 2026 calendar. Tickets are being sold through the Bahrain International Circuit website. Gulf Air is also launching direct flights between Bahrain and Kuala Lumpur in time for the race weekend.

"The feedback from fans and those involved in the sport since we announced The Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia has been incredible. Fans now have their opportunity to ensure they are part of this unique piece of F1 history," said Shaikh Salman bin Isa Al Khalifa, Chief Executive of the Bahrain International Circuit.
Grands Prix in the 'wrong' country: It has happened before

A grand prix being held outside the country whose name it carries is not entirely unprecedented in Formula 1. In previous cases, however, the country lending its name to the race and the country actually hosting it were much closer geographically.
The 1982 Swiss Grand Prix was held at Dijon in France because Switzerland had banned circuit racing following the 1955 Le Mans disaster.
The San Marino Grand Prix was held at Imola in Italy from 1981 to 2006. Italy already had its own Grand Prix at Monza.
In 1997 and 1998, the Nurburgring hosted the Luxembourg Grand Prix.

The most recent Formula 1 race at Sepang was won by Max Verstappen in 2017. Sebastian Vettel holds the record for the most F1 victories at the circuit with four. Other memorable moments include Michael Schumacher's comeback from a broken leg in 1999 and Lewis Hamilton's engine failure in 2016, which cost him valuable points in the championship battle.

The 2026 race will run for 56 laps and cover 310.418 kilometres. Some teams are preparing extensively for Formula 1's return to Sepang. Mercedes, for example, has announced a major upgrade for Malaysia.

The end of the season, meanwhile, remains uncertain. The races in Qatar and Abu Dhabi also depend on developments in the Middle East. Domenicali has already explained when Formula 1 will need to make a decision on the season finale.
Frequently asked questions about the Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia
The race weekend will take place from 2 to 4 October 2026. The race itself will be held on Sunday, 4 October.
Where will the 2026 Bahrain Grand Prix take place?
At the Sepang International Circuit near Kuala Lumpur in Malaysia.
Why is Formula 1 not racing in Bahrain in 2026?
The race scheduled for April was cancelled because of the war in the Middle East. Iranian attacks hit targets in Bahrain close to the circuit.
Why is the race in Malaysia called the Bahrain Grand Prix?
Bahrain remains the nominal host of the event and receives the revenue from ticket sales. Bahrain's national airline Gulf Air remains the title sponsor.
When did Formula 1 last race in Malaysia?
In 2017. Max Verstappen won the most recent Malaysian Grand Prix.

items.titleZh: 加里·安德森：科拉平托事件应由阿尔派内部处理而非国际汽联
items.summaryZh: 阿尔派领队弗拉维奥·布里亚托利表示将考虑对科拉平托在阿塞拜疆大奖赛中撞掉队友加斯利一事采取何种行动，加里·安德森认为车队应靠自身纪律处理此类队内事故，而不只依赖国际汽联的处罚。
items.originalTitle: Gary Anderson: Alpine should handle Colapinto action, not the FIA
items.summaryEn: Franco Colapinto has already received a five-place grid penalty for taking out team-mate Pierre Gasly in the Azerbaijan Grand Prix, and Alpine boss Flavio Briatore says he will consider what further action to take. Gary Anderson argues that teams need their own internal discipline for such incidents rather than relying solely on the FIA's official punishment.
detailZh: 阿尔派车队领队弗拉维奥·布里亚托利明确表示，对于弗兰科·科拉平托在阿塞拜疆大奖赛上撞掉队友皮埃尔·加斯利（以及兰多·诺里斯）一事，他将“考虑应该采取什么行动”，这暗示科拉平托可能还会面临更多麻烦，他已经因这次事故被罚退五位发车。
加里·安德森在F1维修区指挥墙上工作时也处理过不少车队内部冲突的头疼问题。以下是他对于科拉平托事故以及国际汽联和阿尔派车队目前处理方式的看法。
一级方程式乃至整个赛车运动的一条黄金法则就是‘不要撞掉你的队友’。这不应该取决于官方处罚是否与过错相称。
一支车队需要有自己的内部纪律，车手们也必须遵守。所有车队都比任何车手更重要，所以关键在于尊重，但比赛终究是比赛。对于赛场上的任何车手来说，他们都想击败场上另外21辆赛车，实际上这也正是车手能获得正式席位的原因。
本赛季我们已经见证了一些队友之间非常接近的较量。这种情况更多地出现在领跑赛车上，但那只是因为电视导演跟拍的就是这些车。
想想乔治·拉塞尔和基米·安东内利，刘易斯·汉密尔顿和夏尔·勒克莱尔不止一次地展开缠斗，甚至本周末还有马克斯·维斯塔潘和伊萨克·哈贾尔，但这种情况在整个车阵中都在发生；这些赛车和动力单元似乎意味着发车区的构成有点像诺亚方舟上的动物一样成对出现，而当这种情况发生时，它会一直延续到正赛中。
我们看到许多车手在巴库犯下失误；仅举几例，兰多·诺里斯、汉密尔顿和奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里，都出现过锁死车轮的情况，导致他们冲出赛道滑入缓冲区或压上路肩。
对科拉平托来说，那是一个在不恰当时机出现的失误，但当你锁死车轮时，你就只能成为一位乘客（意指无法控制赛车）。那么他是不是就不该尝试去挽回一些名次，反而在安全车重启时损失了几个位置呢？不，赛手的大脑不是这样运作的。
对我来说，小红牛车队的队友林德布拉德和劳森在同一时间发生的事故也是同样的道理。林德布拉德并不是故意撞上他的队友的，只是他一时兴奋起来的时候，那里恰好就是那辆队友的车。
虽然诺里斯是阿尔卑斯车队内部碰撞的无辜受害者，但我认为他赛后爆发、呼吁对科拉平托实施禁赛的言论并不合适。诺里斯自己也多次险些发生类似的碰撞，所以住在玻璃房子里的人，首先要学会的就是不要扔石头。
在我经营车队的那段时间里，这样的事情发生过很多次。1997年在阿根廷，乔丹车队的队友拉尔夫·舒马赫和费斯切拉的碰撞大概是最严重的一次；那次事故让我们失去了一次潜在的胜利，或者至少是两名车手登上领奖台的机会。舒马赫最终仍然以第三名完赛，但凭借我们当时拥有的速度和策略，两名车手那天其实都有争夺胜利的可能。
我们还经历过几次埃尔文和巴里切罗之间的险情，但总的来说，那个年代的赛事干事不会介入，所以一切都要靠在卡车后面趁大家怒气未消时迅速开个会解决，由我告诉他们赶紧把事情处理妥当。
我并不是在纵容科拉平托所做的事；他在一个根本没有机会脱身的时机犯了一个错误，但对我来说，任何训诫都应该由车队来下达。
这显然正是执行顾问弗拉维奥·布里亚托利所采取的老派做法，他表示阿尔派将会“考虑应采取什么行动方案，以便我们从中吸取教训，避免将来再次出现这种情况”。
detailEn: Alpine team boss Flavio Briatore's pointed declaration that he'll "consider what course of action should be taken" over Franco Colapinto taking out team-mate Pierre Gasly (and Lando Norris) in the Azerbaijan Grand Prix suggests there might be more trouble to come for Colapinto, who already has a five-place grid penalty for the incident.
Gary Anderson had to deal with a few intra-team clash headaches in his time on the F1 pitwall. Here's his take on the Colapinto incident and both the FIA and Alpine's handling of it so far.
The one golden rule in Formula 1 and motorsport in general is 'don't wipe out your team-mate'. It shouldn't be down to whether the official penalty fits the crime.

A team needs to have some discipline of its own in place, and the drivers need to buy into it. All the teams are bigger than any of their drivers, so it's all about respect, but racing is racing. For any driver on the grid, they want to beat the other 21 cars that are out there and in reality that is why a driver gets their place on the grid.
We have seen some very close racing between team-mates this season. We've seen it more often with the frontrunning cars, but that's just because that's who the TV director follows.

Think George Russell and Kimi Antonelli, Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc on more than one occasion, even Max Verstappen and Isack Hadjar this weekend, but it happens all the way through the field; these cars and the power units seem to mean that the grid is made up a bit like Noah's Ark, and when that happens it will bleed through to the race itself.
We saw many drivers make mistakes in Baku; Lando Norris, Hamilton and Oscar Piastri, to name but a few, all had lock-ups that sent them down the run-off areas or over the kerbs.

For Colapinto, it was a mistake at the wrong time, but when you lock a wheel, you become a passenger. So should he not have tried to make up some places and in turn, lost a few on the safety car restart? No, that's not how a racing driver's brain is wired.

For me, it is the same for Racing Bulls team-mates Arvid Lindblad and Liam Lawson and their incident at the same time. Lindblad didn't mean to hit his team-mate; it just happened that that was the car that was there when he got a little excited about life.

While he was a helpless casualty of Alpine's intra-team clash, I think Norris's post-race outburst calling for a race ban for Colapinto is out of place. Norris has had his close shaves on various occasions, so when you live in a glass house, the first thing you learn is not to throw stones.

In my time running a team, we had it on many occasions. Jordan team-mates Ralf Schumacher and Giancarlo Fisichella in Argentina in 1997 was probably the worst; it robbed us of a potential win or at least two drivers on the podium. Schumacher still finished third but with the pace and strategy we had, both drivers were in contention that day.

We also had a few close scrapes with Eddie Irvine and Rubens Barrichello, but in general back in those days the stewards didn't get involved, so it was all down to a quick get-together in the back of the truck whilst the blood was still boiling, with me telling them to sort it and quickly.
I'm not condoning what Colapinto did; he made a mistake at a time when there was no opportunity to get out of it, but for me it is up to the team to issue any reprimands.

That certainly seems to be the old-school approach executive advisor Flavio Briatore has taken, as he said Alpine will "consider what course of action should be taken, so we can learn from it and avoid such a situation in future".

items.originalTitle: Race ban talk "too harsh" on Franco Colapinto, George Russell and Max Verstappen say
items.summaryEn: Mercedes driver George Russell believes a race ban would have been "too harsh" on Franco Colapinto after the Argentinian crashed into Pierre Gasly and Lando Norris at the Azerbaijan Grand Prix, a view shared by Max Verstappen.
detailZh: 关于禁赛一场的讨论对弗朗哥·科拉平托来说“过于严苛”，乔治·拉塞尔和马克斯·维斯塔潘如此表示
冠军乔治·拉塞尔和亚军马克斯·维斯塔潘在弗朗哥·科拉平托于F1阿塞拜疆大奖赛引发一场代价高昂的碰撞后，为他进行了辩护
梅赛德斯车手乔治·拉塞尔认为，在这位阿根廷车手在阿塞拜疆大奖赛中撞掉阿尔派车队的队友皮埃尔·加斯利和迈凯伦车队的兰多·诺里斯之后，对弗朗哥·科拉平托处以禁赛一场的处罚会“过于严苛”。
在第36圈重新发车时，科拉平托在巴库街道赛道的1号弯内侧布满灰尘的进弯路线上出现失误，前轮锁死并猛烈撞上加斯利的赛车侧面，导致两位车手双双退赛。诺里斯也在这次事故中被波及，这使得阿尔派车队很可能获得的双积分完赛化为泡影。
加斯利和诺里斯都对科拉平托的驾驶方式感到不满，后者甚至呼吁国际汽联考虑对这种粗心驾驶行为处以禁赛一场的处罚。
"我认为国际汽联应该更加严格，开始对这类行为作出禁赛处罚。这种行为很粗心。它会带来巨额损失，我的所有部件现在都进了垃圾桶。这种人就应该被禁赛，因为这样的驾驶不配出现在一级方程式里,"诺里斯说，随后在晚些时候又重申了这一立场。
当诺里斯的观点被提给本场比赛的前三名完赛者时，冠军拉塞尔对科拉平托的失误表现出更多理解："我个人认为这太严厉了。安全车重启、冷胎状态下，一个很小的失误就可能造成严重后果。从我今天看到的情况来看，就是这样的。这是一个小错误，却带来了严重后果。
"我个人认为，禁赛处罚应该针对那些故意做出非常危险、非常鲁莽行为的车手。所以，我认为这只是不幸的意外。"
去年在奥地利大奖赛起步时被安东内利撞出比赛的亚军维斯塔潘也遭遇过类似命运，他同样比诺里斯更宽容：“只要造成事故的车手意识到自己做了什么并道了歉，对吧？我是说，这种事会发生。一个小失误或误判，你锁死了车轮。
“事故发生在内侧，抓地力很低，然后我猜有点不幸的是牵连了这么多车。对任何被卷入的人来说都不好受，对吧？但就像拉塞尔说的，我觉得禁赛一场可能有点过了。”
登上领奖台的伊萨克·哈贾尔也指出赛道是重要因素，科拉平托的失误只是低抓地力街道表面上众多锁死车轮的情况之一。赛车线外抓地力的不足似乎让车手们不愿尝试在一号弯超车，而这条6公里长的巴库城市赛道正是一号弯提供了主要的超车机会。
“从我的角度来说，我觉得这条赛道不够好，”伤愈复出并拿下第三名的哈贾尔说道。“你一旦离开赛车线，路面就开始变得非常颠簸。
“在安全车后面很难让轮胎产生温度，它的速度相当慢。所以，一旦你操之过急，就会带来非常非常严重的后果。所以，我认为禁赛一场的处罚太过严厉了。”
国际汽联的赛事干事给科拉平托开出了10秒罚时。但由于这位阿尔派车手（阿尔派）的车手已经自己退出了比赛，这一处罚将转换为下周在马来西亚举行的巴林大奖赛的发车位后退五位。
科拉平托为他所谓的“一个大失误”道歉，这次失误也招致了阿尔派车队（阿尔派）负责人弗拉维奥·布里亚托利的愤怒。
detailEn: Race ban talk "too harsh" on Franco Colapinto, George Russell and Max Verstappen say
Winner George Russell and runner-up Max Verstappen have defended Franco Colapinto after he triggered a costly collision in Formula 1's Azerbaijan Grand Prix

Mercedes driver George Russell feels a Formula 1 race ban would have been "too harsh" on Franco Colapinto after the Argentinian took out Alpine team-mate Pierre Gasly and McLaren's Lando Norris in the Azerbaijan Grand Prix.

On a lap 36 restart, Colapinto made an error on the dusty inside approach to Turn 1 of the Baku street circuit, locking up his front tyres and slamming into the side of Gasly, taking both drivers out of the race. Norris was also collected in the incident, which robbed Alpine of a likely double points finish.
Both Gasly and Norris were upset with Colapinto's driving, with the latter even going as far as calling for the FIA to consider a one-race ban for careless driving behaviour.

"I think the FIA should be more strict and start handing out bans for this kind of stuff. It's careless from people. It costs a lot of money; all my parts are in the bin now. People should just get banned, because that's not driving that deserves to be in Formula 1," Norris said, before doubling down on it later.

When Norris' thoughts were put to the race's top three finishers, race winner Russell showed more understanding for Colapinto's blunder: "I think that’s too harsh, personally. I think safety car restarts, cold tyres, a very small mistake can have big consequences. And from what I saw today, that’s what it looked like. It was a small error that had a big consequence.
"I think, personally, race bans should come from drivers intentionally doing something very dangerous and very reckless. So, I think it was unfortunate."

Runner-up Max Verstappen, who suffered a similar fate last year when he was taken out by Kimi Antonelli at the start of the Austrian GP, was also more clement than Norris: "As long as the driver that caused it is aware of what he did and apologised, right? I mean, that happens. A small mistake or misjudgement, you lock up.

"It’s on the inside, low grip, and then I guess it's a bit unfortunate that it involves so many cars. It's not nice for anyone involved, right? But like George said, I think a race ban probably is a bit much."

Podium finisher Isack Hadjar also named the track as an important contributor, with Colapinto's error just one of many lock-ups on the low-grip street surface. The lack of grip off the racing line appeared to discourage drivers from attempting overtakes into Turn 1, the 6km Baku City Circuit's main passing opportunity.
"From my side, I think the track is not good enough," Hadjar said after taking third on his return from injury. "You move out of the racing line, it starts to be very bumpy.
"It’s hard to generate temperature behind the safety car, it’s going quite slowly. So, then you just overdo it and then it has big, big consequences. So, I think a race ban is way too harsh."

The FIA race stewards handed Colapinto a 10-second penalty. But as the Alpine driver eliminated himself from the race, that punishment will be converted into a five-place grid drop for next weekend's Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia.
Colapinto apologised for what he called a "big mistake", which also drew the ire of Alpine chief Flavio Briatore.
keyPointsZh: 科拉平托在巴库赛道第36圈的重启中，在一号弯布满灰尘的内侧路线上出现失误，前轮锁死并撞上了皮埃尔·加斯利和迈凯伦车手兰多·诺里斯的赛车。
科拉平托撞车事故涉及的对象包括他的阿斯顿·马丁前队友加斯利所在的阿尔派车队。
该讨论针对的是是否应对这类撞车事故实施正式禁赛处罚。
keyPointsEn: Colapinto made an error on lap 36 restart, locking up on the dusty inside approach to Turn 1 and hitting both Pierre Gasly and Lando Norris.
The incident occurred on the Baku street circuit during the Azerbaijan Grand Prix.
The debate centred on whether such incidents should result in a formal race ban.

items.titleZh: 奥康巴库第八回应前途质疑：「我就是最好的车手之一，我不怕说出来」
items.summaryZh: 排位赛因黄旗只拿到第14、又身陷2027年哈斯去留传闻的埃斯特班·奥康，在巴库正赛抓住机会、避开混乱，拿到第八——本季迄今最好成绩，也只是他本季第三次进前十。他说：「我和场上每个人都交过手，一直不落下风……我赢过卡丁车、雷诺方程式、三级方程式和GP3，也在F1赢过。我就是最好的车手之一，我不怕说出来。」
items.originalTitle: 'I’m one of the best out there' – Esteban Ocon makes his point after charge to P8 in Baku amid Haas future doubts
detailZh: 埃斯特班·奥康在前途存疑之际为哈斯在阿塞拜疆拿到积分，车队在巴库双车得分。
埃斯特班·奥康坚称自己是当今F1车手中「最好的之一」，他在哈斯前途存疑之际，于巴库漂亮地完成反弹。
2026年对这位法国车手来说很艰难。周五在阿塞拜疆，本有希望进入排位第三节的他因一面黄旗只排到第14，挫败感彻底爆发。
考虑到围绕他2027年哈斯前途的种种猜测——他此前暗示自己「明年肯定是自由身」——这是他最不需要的结果。
周六的正赛里，他以最好的方式作出回应：抓住机会、避开身边的混乱，冲线时获得第八——这是他本赛季迄今的最好成绩，也只是他本季第三次进入前十。
唯一的遗憾是，如果不是在最后一圈冲线时被阿尔维德·林德布拉德超越丢掉一个位置，成绩本可以更好。
尽管如此，他的心情与24小时前相比简直判若两人。
「对这个结果超级开心，」这位法国车手说，「当赛车状态正常时，这就是我们应得的。我们从周末一开始就拥有一台强劲的赛车，在进站、安全车时机上都做了正确的决定。
「所以，是的，这是一场非常非常好的比赛。我对结果非常满意，我觉得这给了所有人良好、积极的氛围，带着它迎接接下来的三连站。
「我们要去的是一条非常困难的赛道，弯道很多，高速弯也很多，而我们已经证明我们的赛车相当有竞争力。所以对我们来说，接下来应该是两场令人兴奋的比赛，我很期待。」
第一次安全车后的重启帮助奥康冲进积分区。当时他排第13，正和利亚姆·劳森争夺进入1号弯的位置，弗朗哥·科拉平托、皮埃尔·加斯利和兰多·诺里斯则因一起碰撞失去竞争力。
已经升至第九的他在2号弯超越了队友奥利·贝尔曼，后者此前与基米·安东内利发生轻碰，丢了速度。
「我超了利亚姆，他在重启时稍微慢了一点，」奥康说，「我当时在他车身中段，他还在前面，但这足以让我进入1号弯。然后我在2号弯直接切进去，超过了奥利。」
第二次重启后，奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里的失误又让他前进一位，两位哈斯车手分别排在第七和第八。
「从那以后，困难的是保持前面的位置，」奥康说。
「但那不可能，因为那些快车一下就跑没影了。所以我们和奥利打起了团队配合。
「最后四五圈我让他超了过去，不幸的是他随后被林德布拉德超越。」
看起来奥康能保持在小红牛之前，但瓦尔特利·博塔斯在比赛末段撞车时，他被打了个措手不及。
「我显然切了弯，因为我不知道瓦尔特利是不是在赛道中间，」奥康说，「我想，我可不想到干事那里争论自己有没有获利，所以我收了油，本以为那样就够了。但他们（小红牛）直道上超级快，我收得太多了。」
林德布拉德在终点线前以仅0.03秒的优势夺走了这个位置。尽管如此，对于一个从未怀疑过自身能力的车手来说，第八名是一份来得正是时候的回报。
「我和场上每个人都交过手，而且一直不落下风，」他说，「我参加过的每一个锦标赛都赢过。我在雷诺方程式赢过比赛，在卡丁车拿过冠军，赢过三级方程式，赢过GP3。我在德国房车大师赛（DTM）跑了半个赛季都在前十，我在F1也赢过。我做得到。我就是最好的车手之一，我不怕说出来。」
这一天对贝尔曼来说也不错，尽管在重启时被队友超越，他仍对拿到第九非常满意。
「很高兴两台车都拿到积分，」他说，「这种感觉太棒了，尽管这是一场有很多车退赛的消耗战——我觉得如果全程是绿旗，我们大概会像我当时那样排在第11。
「不过我们会欣然接受。在这样的比赛里坚持到最后一直是目标。我们知道这种比赛能有多疯狂，今天就很疯狂。我为整个车队感到骄傲，包括工厂里的每一个人，还有在意大利的空气动力学团队。
「在我们带来升级之后就拿到积分，我无法想象他们现在是什么感受——我觉得他们应该为自己感到非常自豪。」
（来源：Formula 1 官网）
detailEn: Esteban Ocon scored for Haas in Azerbaijan amid doubts around his future as the team brought home double points in Baku.
Esteban Ocon has insisted he is "one of the best out there" among the current crop of F1 drivers, as he bounced back in style in Baku amid doubts over his Haas future.
It’s been a tough 2026 for the Frenchman and his frustration boiled over on Friday in Azerbaijan when a yellow flag left him in P14 in Qualifying on a day when Q3 was on the cards.
It was the last thing he needed given the speculation surrounding his Haas future in 2027, after he hinted he was "definitely a free agent for next year."

He responded in the best way possible in Saturday’s race by taking his opportunities and avoiding the chaos around him to claim P8 at the flag – his best result of the season thus far, and only his third top-10 finish.
The only disappointment was that it could have been even better had he not lost a spot to Arvid Lindblad on the dash across the line on the last lap.
Despite that his mood couldn’t have been more different than it had been 24 hours earlier.

“Super happy with the result,” said the Frenchman. “When the car is working, that's what we deserve. We had a strong car since the beginning of the weekend. We took all the right decisions, on the pit stop, on the Safety Car.
“So yeah, it's been it's been a really, really good race. I'm really happy with the result, and I think it gives just good, positive vibes for everyone to move forward on that triple [header].

“We are going into a very difficult track with a lot of corners, a lot of high-speed corners, and we showed that we have a car that's pretty competitive. So it should be two exciting races for us. I'm looking forward to them.”

It was the restart after the first Safety Car that helped to propel Ocon into the points. He was in P13 and fighting with Liam Lawson down to Turn 1 when Franco Colapinto, Pierre Gasly and Lando Norris were taken out of contention by a collision.
Already up to P9, into Turn 2 he passed team mate Ollie Bearman, who lost momentum after a touch with Kimi Antonelli.

“I overtook Liam, who was a little bit slow on the line,” said Ocon. “I was mid of the car, he was still in front, but that gave me enough to go into Turn 1. And then I just dived into Turn 2, into Ollie, and got in front of him.”
After the second restart a mistake from Oscar Piastri handed him another place, leaving the two Haas drivers in P7 and P8.
“From there on what was going to be difficult was to keep the overtake in front,” said Ocon.
“And that was not possible, because the quick cars, they just disappeared. So we were playing the team game with Ollie.
“I gave him overtake for the last four or five laps until he got overtaken by Lindblad, unfortunately.”
It looked like Ocon would be able to stay in front of the Racing Bulls, but then he was caught out when Valtteri Bottas crashed in the closing stages.

"Obviously I cut the corner because I didn't know if Valtteri was in the middle of the track,” said Ocon. “I thought I don't want to be at the stewards arguing that I gained an advantage, so I backed off, and I thought that was going to be enough. But they [Racing Bulls] are super-fast in the straight, and I overdid it.”
Lindblad got him on the line to claim the place by just 0.03s. Nevertheless P8 was a timely reward for someone who has never doubted his own ability.

“I've raced with everyone out there, and I've always been on par,” he said. “I've won every championship that I've raced with. I've won races in Formula Renault, I won championships in go-karts, I won Formula 3, I won GP3. I was racing in the top 10 in DTM for half a season, I won in Formula 1. I can do it. I'm one of the best out there and I'm not afraid to say it.”
It was a good day too for Bearman, who was more than happy to claim P9 despite losing out to his team mate at the restart.

“I'm super happy to score points with both cars,” he said. “It's such an incredible feeling, even if it was a race of attrition with a lot of retirements, where I think if it was green, we would have been P11, like where I was.

“However, we'll take it. To stay in a race like this is always the target. We know how crazy they can be, and it was crazy today, and I'm so proud of the entire team, everyone back home at the factory, also in Italy, the aero guys.
“To bring points after the upgrade that we bought, I can't imagine how they're feeling right now – I think they should be very proud of themselves.”

detailZh: 弗朗哥·科拉平托：阿尔卑斯车队领队弗拉维奥·布里亚托利将在车手“非常糟糕”的阿塞拜疆大奖赛撞车后决定“应对方案”
弗朗哥·科拉平托在巴库第一次安全车重启时的失误，引发了一场连环事故，牵涉到队友皮埃尔·加斯利和迈凯伦的兰多·诺里斯；请从周五早上起通过天空体育F1频道收看F1重返马来西亚的直播，雪邦赛道将举办巴林大奖赛

阿尔卑斯车队领队弗拉维奥·布里亚托利表示，他将会花时间“反思应当采取何种应对方案”，此前弗朗哥·科拉平托“非常糟糕”的失误在阿塞拜疆大奖赛上引发了一场三车相撞事故。
在第一次安全车重启时，科拉平托试图从第10位大胆地从内侧切入一号弯，结果刹车抱死，撞上了队友皮埃尔·加斯利的赛车侧面，加斯利随即被撞向外侧兰多·诺里斯的迈凯伦。三位车手全部退赛。
加斯利当时正处在强势的第七位，这起事故让阿尔派损失了本可到手的七分。

由于两辆阿尔派赛车和诺里斯都在他之前退赛，阿维德·林德布拉德在比赛末段顺势上位，最终以第七名完赛，使小红牛（小红牛）在车队总冠军第五名的争夺中对阿尔派的领先优势扩大到15分，而本赛季还剩下计划中的八轮比赛。
在赛后阿尔派官方新闻稿中，高管顾问布里亚托利明确表达了对科拉平托驾驶方式的不满，这位阿根廷车手对此毫无保留地道歉。布里亚托利表示，他们会认真研究如何确保吸取教训，避免未来再次发生类似情况。
布里亚托利说："显然，我对今天比赛的结果感到极其失望，要知道我们在争夺总冠军的过程中损失了宝贵的积分。"
这类事故不应该发生，尤其是当时我们两辆车都跑得很好，都处在能获得积分的位置上。
弗兰科·科拉平托在第一次安全车重新起步时将两辆车都撞了出去，随后向皮埃尔·加斯利和兰多·诺里斯表达了歉意。
"我感到非常对不起车队，也对不起皮埃尔，他整个周末都表现出色，同时我也要向兰多·诺里斯和迈凯伦道歉，因为我毁掉了他们的比赛。"
“我知道弗朗科已经承担了全部责任，他也确实应该这样做；考虑到比赛和安全车重启的局面，他刹车实在踩得太晚了。对于一名有着他这种经验的车手来说，这是一个非常糟糕的操作。
“我想花点时间反思此事，并考虑应当采取什么行动，这样我们才能从中吸取教训，避免将来再出现类似情况。”
科拉平托将在下周于马来西亚举行的巴林大奖赛中接受发车退后五位发车的处罚，以替代他在比赛中未能执行的10秒罚时，因为他此前已经退赛。
“重启之后，COL从后方接近进入1号弯的GAS。COL刹车过晚，以一个无法让他受控过弯的速度从内侧进入弯道。
他冲过了弯角，并与GAS的左侧发生碰撞，随后GAS又撞上了NOR，两辆车都退出了比赛。
干事们认为，这次碰撞的全部或主要责任在COL。
尽管事故发生在重启后的第一个弯角，但没有其他车手的因素足以支持适用首圈/首弯更为宽松的处理方式。
导致碰撞的标准处罚是10秒罚时。
"由于科拉平托已经从比赛中退赛，因此无法执行时间处罚，干事们将该处罚转换为在其参加的下一场比赛中退后五个发车位的处罚。"
在事故发生后的第一时间，诺里斯感到沮丧，他表示像科拉平托那样引发此类事故的车手应该被禁赛一场。
诺里斯所在的迈凯伦车队领队安德里亚·斯特拉表示，他们相信干事们会做出正确的决定，并补充说，也应该要求车手在比赛中具备"一定程度的基本常识"。
"这是一个复杂的问题，"斯特拉在科拉平托的发车位退后处罚被正式确认之前这样说道。
"我想这件事现在几乎正在接受干事们的审查。我确信布里亚托利也会进行审查。我不知道哪一方对造成这个问题的人会更严厉。
"我认为，即使有处罚带来的震慑作用，当你在F1驾驶、在巴库接近1号弯时，你看过那么多过往的视频，你就应该利用好这些经验，这是作为一名F1车手应该具备的。
诺里斯在阿塞拜疆大奖赛上被撞出比赛后表达不满
"这件事的后果，我确定，对阿尔卑斯车队的两位车手来说都很遗憾，而其他车手也因此受到了处罚。
“处罚肯定应该考虑到，在某些赛道上你必须格外谨慎，而且以往已经发生过很多类似的问题，尤其是在街道赛道上，根本没有缓冲区可以用来减轻别人撞上你造成的后果。
“我们信任干事以及他们的处理方式，但更重要的是，我认为我们应该信任车手在驾驶时会保持一定程度的基本常识。”
“这太苛刻了”——拉塞尔、维斯塔潘、哈贾尔都不同意禁赛一场的提议
在巴库站比赛后的新闻发布会上，记者向周六排位前三名问起诺里斯的言论，但三人都一致认为，因为这样一次事故就禁赛车手一场比赛，未免太过分了。
巴库大奖赛冠军拉塞尔表示：“我个人认为这个处罚太重了。”
“我认为安全车重启时，轮胎是冷的，一个很小的失误就可能造成很大的后果。”
“从我今天看到的情况来看，就是这样的。那是一个小错误，却带来了很大的后果。我个人认为，禁赛处罚应该是针对车手故意做出非常危险、非常鲁莽的行为。所以我觉得这只是不幸。”
在这场比赛中以微弱差距获得第二名的红牛车手维斯塔潘补充说：“我认为，当然，只要造成事故的车手意识到自己做了什么，并且道了歉，就没问题。”
detailEn: Franco Colapinto: Alpine chief Flavio Briatore to decide 'course of action' after driver's 'very poor' Azerbaijan GP crash

Franco Colapinto's mistake at first Safety Car restart in Baku led to chain-reaction accident with team-mate Pierre Gasly and McLaren's Lando Norris; watch Formula 1's return to Malaysia from Friday morning live on Sky Sports F1 as Sepang hosts the Bahrain Grand Prix
There was carnage on the safety car restart after contact between Alpine team-mates resulted in Lando Norris crashing out of the Azerbaijan Grand Prix

Alpine chief Flavio Briatore says he will take time to "reflect on what course of action should be taken" after Franco Colapinto's "very poor" error caused a three-car collision in the Azerbaijan Grand Prix.

Attempting to make a bold move from 10th place down the inside into Turn One at the first Safety Car restart, Colapinto locked his brakes and hit the side of team-mate Pierre Gasly, who was sent straight into Lando Norris' McLaren on his outside. All three drivers retired.
Gasly had been running a strong seventh at the time and the incident cost Alpine what stood as seven points overall.

With both Alpines and Norris having dropped out ahead of him, Arvid Lindblad instead came through late in the race to finish seventh and stretch Racing Bulls' lead over Alpine in the fight for fifth place in the Constructors' Championship to 15 points with a scheduled eight rounds left.

Speaking in Alpine's official press release after the race, executive advisor Briatore made clear his frustration at Colapinto's driving, for which the Argentine unreservedly apologised, and said they would work out what to do to ensure lessons were learnt to avoid a repeat in future.
"Obviously I'm extremely disappointed with the outcome of today's race, knowing we lost valuable points in the Championship fight," said Briatore.
"These sorts of incidents shouldn't happen, particularly when we were running well with both cars in point-scoring positions.
Franco Colapinto was apologetic to Pierre Gasly and Lando Norris after he took both out at the first safety car restart
"I feel very sorry for the team and for Pierre who did a great job all weekend and my apologies also go to Lando [Norris] and McLaren for ruining their race.

"I know that Franco has taken full responsibility for it, as he should; in fact he braked far too late considering the context of the race and the safety car restart. It was a very poor move for a driver of his experience.
"I want to take time to reflect on it and consider what course of action should be taken, so we can learn from it and avoid such a situation in future."
Colapinto will take a five-place grid penalty at this coming week's Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia in lieu of the 10-second time penalty he was unable to serve in the race as he had retired.

"Following the restart, COL approached GAS from behind into Turn 1. COL braked too late and entered the corner on the inside at a speed which did not allow him to make the corner in a controlled manner.
"He overshot the corner and made contact with the left-hand side of GAS, who then hit NOR and both cars retired.
"The Stewards considered that COL was wholly or predominantly to blame for the collision.

"Although the incident occurred at the first corner following the restart, there was no contribution from another driver which would justify applying the first-lap / first corner more lenient approach.
"The standard penalty for causing a collision is a 10-second time penalty.

"As COL had retired from the Race and was therefore unable to serve the time penalty, the Stewards converted the penalty to a drop of five grid positions at the next Race in which the driver participates."
Speaking in the immediate aftermath of the incident, a frustrated Norris said that drivers who cause incidents like Colapinto did should be banned for one race.
Andrea Stella, Norris' McLaren team boss, said they trusted the stewards to make the right decisions, adding that drivers should also be expected to race with "a certain degree of just common sense".
"It's a complex matter," said Stella before Colapinto's converted grid drop was officially confirmed.
"I guess this is being reviewed by the stewards as we speak, pretty much. I'm sure it will be reviewed by Flavio as well. I'm not sure which one is going to be harsher for whoever caused the problem.

"I think, independently of the dissuasion that you can have because of the penalty, I think when you drive in Formula 1 and you are approaching Turn 1 in Baku and you have seen so many videos of the past, you just should be capitalising on this experience that you should be having as a Formula 1 driver.
Lando Norris hits out after being taken out at the Azerbaijan GP
"The consequence in this case, which I'm sure, is a shame for Alpine for both drivers, and there's a penalty for other drivers.

"Definitely the penalty should take into account that there are some circuits in which you have to use extra prudency, and there's a full history of problems that happened like this, especially in a street circuit where there's no way to use the runoff area to somehow mitigate the consequences of somebody running onto you.
"We trust the stewards, their approach, but above all, we should trust the drivers that they apply a certain degree of just common sense I would say while driving."
'That's too harsh' - Russell, Verstappen, Hadjar disagree with race ban suggestion

Saturday's top-three finishers in Baku were asked in the post-race press conference about Norris' comments but all agreed that banning a driver for a race for such an incident would be a step too far.
Baku race winner George Russell said: "I think that's too harsh, personally.
"I think Safety Car restarts, cold tyres, a very small mistake can have big consequences.

"And from what I saw today, that's what it looked like. It was a small error that had a big consequence. I think, personally, race bans should come from drivers intentionally doing something very dangerous and very reckless. So I think it was unfortunate."
Red Bull's Max Verstappen, who finished a close second in the race, added: "I think as long as, of course, the driver that caused it is aware of what he did, right, and apologised.
